day_titles.3: Punakha dzong and the suspension bridge

1: Arrival at Bagdogra or Siliguri and transfer to Phuentsholing
Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
Optional: the Zorig Chusum school of arts
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
3: Breakfast, then out into the capital
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
The long suspension bridge over the Po Chhu
Prayer flags strung the length of the span
4: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
Tashichho Dzong and the takin preserve
5: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
6: Breakfast, then the long run back south
Down through the Chukha gorge to the plains
Optional: Zangto Pelri Lhakhang in the town
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Border formalities and transfer to Siliguri

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Punakha comes as a day trip here, so you keep the same Thimphu hotel and skip one set of packing.
expert.tip: The Punakha day crosses Dochula twice. Sit on the left going out for the chortens and the right coming back for the gorge.

summary: 7 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Paro, with 6 nights, Breakfast and dinner each day and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the punakha sightseeing tour, the punakha suspension bridge, the thimphu sightseeing tour, the hike to the tiger's nest.
included: Included: 6 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Paro with Breakfast and dinner each day; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Punakha suspension bridge; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
